value.rationale: For a natural infinite family of graph-incidence posets with exponentially many order ideals, it supplies a complete closed orbit census and a uniform sharp period 24. The 48-support reduction is a structural mechanism explaining why the order is bounded, rather than a one-off enumeration or a small numerical improvement. The primitive 24-cycles for n>=3 distinguish this family from known complete-graph Boolean rank-selection dynamics.
